notes.title: Hotfix 2/22/2024
notes.content: * Fixed ghosts follows mouse players when the player approached a flock of crows in the farm map.

notes.title: Add symbols to Quest objectives
notes.content:
* Added symbols to Quest objectives
* Fixed game difficulty not working in chapter 2

notes.title: Adjust balance
notes.content: * Increase the difficulty of the game slightly.

notes.title: Reduce the difficulty of repairing air conditioners
notes.content:
* Reduced air conditioner repair time from 90 to 75 seconds.
* Progress bar decreased When pressing the wrong button from 20% to 7%
* The chance of the bulb breaking is reduced from 100% to 40% When pressing the wrong button

notes.title: Hotfix 1/3/2024
notes.content:
* Fixed rats not running (when playing with 4 players)
* Reduce rats speed

notes.title: Hotfix 1/2/2024
notes.content:
* fix some text
* Teddy bears are easier to find than before. (When Ghost is Hunting)
* Delete the fox doll.
* Prevent spam, doorbells and teddy bear sounds.

notes.title: Reduce the difficulty of the game.
notes.content:
* Increase battery spawn in the house when ghost is hunting  (from1 to 3)
* Increase starter camera battery 
* Player's Energy bar is harder to reduce when Quest Stage is high. (no instant kills anymore)
* Reduced ghost hunting time from 200 seconds to 120 seconds if the teddy bear cannot be found.
* Increases the chance that painkiller will spawn in front of the house when the doorbell rings.
* Added light bulbs to the map to make it easier for players to find them when they spawn.
* Reduced air conditioner repair time from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
* Reduced the number of spawn rats in Multiplayer mode.
